item.description: Hong Kong customs has requested the removal of e-commerce and social media listings by drug dealers who used the name of Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei as a code name to push “space oil”, also known as etomidate. Yang’s name was just one example of the subtle linguistic workarounds used by illicit vendors to evade platform filters. Customs had made about 64 requests to remove illicit items from platforms including Taobao, JD.com and Pinduoduo since signing agreements with them over the past year,... item.title: Tests on 8 frozen Inca mummies sacrificed show they had chewed coca leaves and had drunk alcohol
item.description: A remarkable archaeological find has revealed eight frozen mummies of children from the Inca Empire, believed to have been sacrificed. Analysis of their hair and nails showed they've ingested coca and alcohol, hinting at a diversity of ritual practices based on local customs. Notably, one mummy, Juanita, contained harmine traces, suggesting specialized ritualistic preparations. This research unveils a rich tapestry of ancient cultural traditions and ceremonies. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
